opening_message:
Ticket 1: Richard Davis (employee ID E011) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E011.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Richard Davis (E011) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Requested write access to Payroll, which is at or below the full-time maximum (write; admin allowed only for role owners). Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Richard Davis (E011) is a CONTRACTOR with BASIC security training (HR note says full_time — discrepancy). Contractors get read, or write only with advanced training. Requested write exceeds maximum, so recommend granting read.
reason: The Security note identifies Richard Davis (E011) as a contractor with basic security training and flags a discrepancy with HR's full_time classification. Under policy, contractors with basic training max out at read (write requires advanced training; admin never for contractors). The requested write exceeds the contractor maximum, so the maximum of read is granted.
